title: Fixed Open Hopper and Cranked Perforated Drum Grater
description: One newly authored complete fixed hand-cranked drum-grater appearance. A whole lower curved cradle and two open bearing rims hold a single connected genuinely perforated horizontal drum with complete end rings and ribs. Its left receiving mouth is open, while a full right back disc joins a side spindle, crank and thick grip. Above it a real open deep hopper joins a long rear hand grip; one thick pressure pad and rear lever are fixed raised about a real transverse pin. The drum occupies the lower hopper throat and the back disc closes its far end; no unobstructed through-bore is claimed. Entirely new geometry, not an old box grater curved into a tube or a two-roll wringer with one roll deleted. Three opaque materials, one prop zero scenes. All edges finite and blunt, empty static exterior only: no food, blades, grating or crank action, pressure, hygiene, human fit, manufacture, operation or safety performance. Small flat foot only establishes display datum. Rigging animation interaction not made.
